column1: # The six old HDFS bugs of system/hdfs-buggy-detect (owner 2026-10-25): each runs the ad hoc check of the point its
# bug lives at on a tree of its own, graphchecker/hdfs-checks with that bug put back by hand and a workload for it
# (experiments/hadoop/trees.tsv, hadoop-hdfs-bug-<jira>). The case directory hdfs-buggy-<jira> declares the check;
# its README the bug, the point, what was put back and why, and the result.
